behaviorMappings.name: does not reserve a Classic SDK owner while the change ownership lock is held
behaviorMappings.retiredMechanism: Holding an ordinary Classic ownership process/file lock blocks owner reservation/init and produces a lock timeout.

target.fullName: Runtime JSON command ignores retired Classic ownership lock files without replacing an existing SDK owner or Run

behaviorMappings.expected: Stale lock artifacts do not block current SDK start. Same request returns original Run unchanged; different input fails RUN_CONFLICT without replacing owner/Run.
behaviorMappings.forbidden: Requesting a lock token/stop proof, acquiring old lock, changing stale historical bytes, overwriting another owner or existing business Run/state.

behaviorMappings.name: does not initialize legacy Classic state while the change ownership lock is held
behaviorMappings.retiredMechanism: Holding an ordinary Classic ownership process/file lock blocks owner reservation/init and produces a lock timeout.

target.fullName: Runtime JSON command initializes legacy Classic despite obsolete lock files and rejects a duplicate without replacing its owner or state

behaviorMappings.expected: Stale lock artifacts do not block explicit compat init. Duplicate init fails without replacing original owner/state.
behaviorMappings.forbidden: Requesting a lock token/stop proof, acquiring old lock, changing stale historical bytes, overwriting another owner or existing business Run/state.
